title: [Salty's Services, Warehouse]
description: A fire has swept through the area, only affecting one side of the storefronts along the broad path.  These ruined buildings are now a mix of burned driftwood, fire-marked metal, ruined cloth, and dark, debris-mixed sand that is piled high atop the entire mess, likely to help smother the initial blaze and subsequent smoldering remains.  Small wooden posts linked by thick rope separate the ruins from the path and the surviving shops across from them, which carry on unmarred by the fire.
